source_section: Methods / Statistical analyses / FUMA and FAVOR annotation, gene-prioritization and functional enrichment pipeline
source_review: The paper describes FUMA/FAVOR jointly and names MAGMA separately. It does not identify every FAVOR scoring function or its historical code revision.

FAVOR_reference.title: FAVOR: functional annotation of variants online resource and annotator for variation across the human genome

implemented_FAVOR_scope: Original pinned current offline CSV annotator plus complete independent native/GDS/scalar/ledger audits and explicit scalar export;not a historical full-paper pipeline.
rule: Do not assign every joint step to FAVOR or infer a raw-PC model from P-only GWAS inputs. Supplied annotations and cohort/reference/build/model/correction families remain explicit.
